title: Ear tubes
what: The surgeon places a tiny tube in the eardrum. It lets fluid drain from the middle ear and lets air in.
why: For frequent ear infections, or fluid behind the eardrum that does not clear for a long time and affects hearing.
duration: surgery usually takes 15 to 30 minutes; you usually go home the same day
tell_doctor: If your child was ill in the past 2 weeks
Any problems with anesthesia in the patient or relatives

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Hearing is usually tested, and blood tests are done. The clinic will give you a list.

prepare.title: Anesthetist
prepare.text: Before surgery, an anesthetist will talk with you.

prepare.title: Food and drink
prepare.text: The clinic will tell you the last time for food and drink. Follow it exactly.

prepare.title: For a child
prepare.text: Tell them calmly that they will have a nap, and you will be close by.

bring: A change of clothes and a favorite toy
steps: The patient changes clothes, sometimes an IV line is placed
Anesthesia is given, and the patient falls asleep
Working through the ear under a microscope, the surgeon makes a tiny cut in the eardrum
Fluid is suctioned out of the ear
The patient wakes up in recovery and goes home a few hours later
feel: After anesthesia: sleepiness, and fussiness in children
Sometimes a little discharge from the ear in the first days
after: Use ear drops as your doctor prescribes
Your doctor will tell you how to keep water out of the ears
The tubes usually fall out on their own after a few months
red_flags: A fever over 38°C (100.4°F), or severe pain
Pus or blood from the ear for several days
Your child has trouble breathing or will not wake up: call emergency services

faq.q: Will the tube need to be removed?
faq.a: It usually falls out on its own. If not, the doctor will decide what to do.

faq.q: Can my child bathe and swim?
faq.a: It depends on your doctor's advice. Often you are told to keep water out of the ears.

reminders.text: Ear tube surgery tomorrow. Food and drink strictly until the time the clinic gave you.
